messages:
elaine.w: Hey team — my Q1 bonus hit today and my net is $1,150 less than I expected. I relocated from MA -> NH on 2026-03-20 and updated address in ADP on 3/21. Bonus payrun PR-2026-04-02-9902 shows MA state withheld on the bonus line. NH has no income tax; can someone check why MA supplemental tax applied?

rit a.payroll: @elaine.w can you confirm the gross bonus amount and the MA withholding shown on the stub? Also confirm W-4/state filing status.

elaine.w: Gross bonus was $5,000. MA state withheld $1,150 (which looks like a supplemental rate). I have a copy of the stub uploaded to the portal under Pay > PR-2026-04-02-9902. I did not submit a new state withholding form because NH has no state tax.

payroll-bot: PR-2026-04-02-9902 processed 2026-04-02 07:30 UTC. Employee payroll state on record: MA. Pay element: BONUS_Q1_2026. Federal supplemental withholding: standard. (automated note)

rita.payroll: Thanks. It appears the address change synced to HR but payroll used the employee state on file at cut (MA) when applying supplemental bonus tax. Bonus logic uses payrun state at processing time, not service date. I'll open vendor ticket to request reversal of MA withholding on the bonus and an off-cycle net top-up if they can.

sam.finance: For GL: if vendor can refund the withheld MA tax we'll do an off-cycle top-up and a reversing entry to "misc_pay_corrections". If not, fallback is W-2 adjustment. Need gross bonus and MA withheld (got it). Also need bank last4 for off-cycle.

elaine.w: Bank last4 are 6789. Stub screenshot is in the portal. I'm W-2 and full-time.

tom.hr: I've attached the relocation confirmation and NH driver's license scan to the vendor ticket and flagged the employee record to use NH state for future runs. Also creating an internal ops ticket to review bonus withholding flow around middle-of-month relocations.

rita.payroll: Vendor ticket PAY-4707 created, requesting expedited refund and an off-cycle deposit of +$1,150 net. Asking vendor about whether supplemental taxes on bonuses should be based on current payroll state vs payment date; this might be a known config nuance.

payroll-bot: PAY-4707 logged. SLA 72 hours. Status: vendor triage. Next update expected 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC.

sam.finance: Noted. Hold expense code "bonus_miswithhold" until resolved. If vendor declines refund, we'll prepare a reversing journal and schedule a manual net correction in next payroll or issue W-2c.

rita.payroll: If vendor approves we'll process off-cycle next Tue. If they require a manual reversal we'll coordinate with finance on timing. I'll update this thread when PAY-4707 moves.

elaine.w: Thanks all 97 appreciate the help. One ask: can ops please check bonus logic so future mid-month movers don't get taxed twice? :pray: 

tom.hr: Will do. Creating internal ticket OPS-1422 to investigate and recommend change (likely change: bonus supplemental tax should reference employee state as of payment date if address change completed before payrun cutoff).
